title: Faculty Info Professor of Practice, Emeritus Degrees Ed.D., Harvard University, (1990)
bio: Tom Hehir is an advocate for children with disabilities in the education system and has written on special education, education reform, due process, and least restrictive environment issues. He was director of the U.S. Department of Education's Office of Special Education Programs from 1993 to 1999.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
